Related Indus instrumentation listings, as shown on their own pages: AC/DC Converter Package, 400 V AC → 24 V DC, NEMA 4X Enclosure, 1 kW: AC/DC converter package powering DC control circuits from a high-voltage AC mains supply. 400 V AC input → 24 V DC output, 1 kW continuous duty. NEMA 4X enclosure containing the converter, input breaker, output power-supply connections, status LEDs and surge protection.
Voltage variants: 230 / 380 / 415 / 440 / 460 V AC input; 12 / 24 V DC output. Output powers 250 W / 500 W / 1 kW / 2 kW. Hazardous-area Ex-d variant available. | Analogic Pressure Sensor, 2-inch Fig.1502 Debooster, 6-inch Gauge + Adjustable Shutdown: 2-inch Fig.1502 pressure debooster providing safe transfer of HP wellhead pressure to the analogic gauge circuit. 6-inch glycerine-filled gauge for smooth pointer reading. Adjustable overpressure shutdown proximity switch enables interlock with ESD logic and shutdown sequencers.
Pressure ranges to 15,000 psi available. SS316 wetted connections; NACE MR-0175 on request. | Coriolis Mass Flowmeter (NRD), 2-inch, Cementing Service, Local + Remote Display: Coriolis-tube mass flowmeter providing simultaneous mass flow, fluid density, and fluid temperature outputs. Used as a non-radioactive densitometer (NRD) for cementing units, hydration units, and Liquid Additive Systems where radioactive source devices are restricted.
2-inch process connections as standard; 1-inch and 3-inch available. Local digital display + 4-20 mA remote outputs. ATEX Zone 1 / 2 enclosure variants. | Multi-Channel Data Acquisition System, 15-inch Touchscreen, USB Export, Frac-Fleet Ready: Multi-channel oilfield Data Acquisition System engineered for pumping-unit and frac-fleet integration. Compatible signal types: 4-20 mA, 0-5 V, pulse, frequency. 15-inch touchscreen (9-inch and 11-inch variants available).
Operator-configurable display modes: data, chart, curves. Local storage and USB export in ASCII / Excel for post-job reports. Network connectivity (wired / wifi) to fleet Data Vans for centralized fleet control. | Explosion-Proof Electrical Panel, Aluminium-Cast, ATEX Zone 1, 600 mm × 800 mm: Explosion-proof aluminium-cast electrical panel for ATEX Zone 1 hazardous-area deployment. 600 mm × 800 mm internal envelope; multiple sizes available. IECEx-certified variants available. Weatherproof steel-sheet enclosure (powder-coated) for non-hazardous deployment as a lower-cost option. IP65 / IP66 sealing as standard. | Electronic Pressure Sensor, 0-15,000 psi, 2-inch Fig.1502M, 4-20 mA: 0-15,000 psi electronic pressure sensor with 2-inch Fig.1502M HP hammer-union connection. 4-20 mA loop output; HART / digital options available. SS316 wetted parts as standard; NACE MR-0175 materials for sour-service.
Pressure ranges 0-5,000 / 0-10,000 / 0-15,000 / 0-20,000 psi. Temperature compensation calibrated across operating range. | Magnetic Flowmeter, 2-inch Wafer, 600 psi, 4-20 mA Output: 2-inch wafer-style magnetic flowmeter with 600 psi MAWP and 4-20 mA loop output. Sizes 1/2 inch to 12 inch available; pressure ratings to ANSI 600. ATEX Zone 1 explosion-proof variant on request. | Magnetic-Pickup Proximity Sensor, 5/8-18 UNF, M12 Connector, Stroke / RPM Counter: Magnetic-pickup proximity sensor used as a bolt-counter on triplex / quintuplex pump crank shafts to feed RPM and calculated displacement back to the unit DAQ. 5/8-18 UNF threaded body with M12 4-pin connector.
No onboard power required — output is a passive signal proportional to shaft speed. Hazardous-area-rated variants available. | Bimetal Thermometer + Thermowell Pair, 1/2-inch NPT M×F, P+U API 6A Range, SS316: Matched bimetal thermometer and thermowell pair. The thermometer has a 1/2-inch NPT male connection with selectable stem length (2.5, 4, 6, 9 inch) and an API 6A P+U temperature range (-20 °F to +250 °F).
The thermowell is integral construction in SS316 with 1/2-inch NPT male-to-female connections, sized to match the thermometer stem. SS304 wetted-parts variant available. Pressure rating to 15,000 psi at process side; bore size selectable. | Turbine Flowmeter, 2-inch Fig.1502 F×M, 15,000 psi, Frac / Cementing Service: 2-inch turbine flowmeter for high-pressure frac and cementing service. Fig.1502 F×M connections at 15,000 psi MAWP. Optical or magnetic pickup output with K-factor calibration certificate.
3-inch and lower-pressure variants available. NACE MR-0175 materials on request for sour-service applications. | VFD Package, AC Motor + Drive, 500 HP, ATEX Zone 2, Frac-Pumper Compatible: VFD (Variable Frequency Drive) package supplying a 500 HP AC motor for oilfield pump duty. Replaces costly DC converter and DC motor systems on legacy units. ATEX Zone 2 enclosure; regenerative braking option for energy recovery on deceleration.
Motor + drive system rated for offshore environment (saltwater, vibration, temperature). Sizes 100 / 250 / 500 / 750 / 1,000 HP available. Compatible with frac pumper, cementing unit, transfer pump and stimulation unit deployments.

Figures of this listing, as shown on its product page: Explosion-proof aluminium-cast electrical panel for ATEX Zone 1 hazardous-area deployment. 600 mm × 800 mm internal envelope; multiple sizes available. Internal mounting plate houses breakers, contactors, relays, terminal blocks, and surge protection per project schematic.
IECEx-certified variants available. Weatherproof steel-sheet enclosure (powder-coated) for non-hazardous deployment as a lower-cost option. IP65 / IP66 sealing as standard.

ATEX Zone 1 is an area where an explosive gas atmosphere is likely to occur occasionally in normal operation; Zone 2 is an area where it is not likely in normal operation and, if it occurs, lasts only for a short time. Ex-d denotes flameproof enclosure protection.

faqs.q: What is a 600 mm by 800 mm explosion-proof aluminium-cast electrical panel used for?
faqs.a: It is an explosion-proof aluminium-cast electrical panel for ATEX Zone 1 hazardous areas, with a 600 mm by 800 mm internal envelope and a mounting plate for breakers, contactors, relays, terminal blocks and surge protection. See the [electrical panels shelf](/c/ic-electrical-panels).

faqs.q: What can be mounted inside the explosion-proof electrical panel?
faqs.a: The internal mounting plate houses breakers, contactors, relays, terminal blocks and surge protection per your project schematic. Send the schematic so the layout fits.

faqs.q: What sizes does the explosion-proof panel come in?
faqs.a: This listing is 600 mm by 800 mm internal, and multiple sizes are available. State the equipment to be fitted. Send us the details and we confirm the specification before supply.

faqs.q: What sealing does the explosion-proof panel have?
faqs.a: IP65 / IP66 sealing is standard. The weatherproof steel-sheet option is for non-hazardous areas. Send us the details and we confirm the specification before supply.

faqs.q: What material is the explosion-proof panel made of?
faqs.a: Aluminium-cast. A weatherproof powder-coated steel-sheet enclosure is the lower-cost option for non-hazardous deployment. Send us the details and we confirm the specification before supply.

faqs.q: Is the explosion-proof panel certified to IECEx?
faqs.a: IECEx-certified variants are available according to the listing. State the certification you need when you ask. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: Which ATEX zone is the panel for?
faqs.a: The panel is for ATEX Zone 1 deployment. Zone 1 is an area where an explosive gas atmosphere is likely to occur occasionally in normal operation.

faqs.q: How is the explosion-proof panel specified?
faqs.a: Give the internal size, the devices to be fitted and the certification needed; the panel is then built per the project schematic. See the [oilfield instrumentation guide](/blog/oilfield-pressure-and-flow-instrumentation).

faqs.q: What do I need to tell Indus to quote the the explosion-proof electrical panel?
faqs.a: Quote the full title, Explosion-Proof Electrical Panel, Aluminium-Cast, ATEX Zone 1, 600 mm × 800 mm, with the variant, size or voltage you need, and say where it will be used and which standard or zone applies. We confirm the specification and lead time on the quotation; start on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Explosion-proof or weatherproof panel: which should I choose?
faqs.a: The aluminium-cast panel is for ATEX Zone 1 hazardous areas, while the powder-coated steel-sheet enclosure is a lower-cost option for non-hazardous deployment. Choose on the area classification.

faqs.q: Where is the explosion-proof electrical panel supplied from?
faqs.a: We supply it from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide. Send the zone, size and schematic. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: Is the explosion-proof electrical panel in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, we carry the explosion-proof electrical panel in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Request pricing for your sizes through [our contact page](/contact).
